title: Big Dreams

heroImage.alt: Tall steel sculpture with a circular web and three metal feathers arranged vertically, standing on a square base outdoors.

images.alt: Close view of the circular metal web and its concentric wires, with upper portions of the feathers visible.
Full view of the circular web, three metal feathers, and square base in a grassy setting.
Full sculpture from another angle, showing the circular web and long feather forms against a blue sky.
The full sculpture displayed on a sidewalk in front of a storefront, with a fire hydrant nearby.

description:
Big Dreams takes the dreamcatcher, once a small token of protection, and rebuilds it at an imposing scale in steel and stainless steel. Its oversized web is engineered for modern-day protection.

The work stands against the constant forces competing to shape what we fear, value, believe, and aspire to become. If a dreamcatcher is a filter for our thoughts and dreams, who is weaving yours?
